protocol: understand the current artifact and preserved gains
refine defects, contradictions, and unsupported assumptions
repeat only when another meaningful improvement is feasible
invariants: do not repeat work merely to appear active
add at least one feasible meaningful improvement
end with completed, verified, blocked, unresolved, and next highest-value action

composition.precedence: after stone governing laws and before mission-specific style

verification.status_rule: UNVERIFIED until composition and regression tests pass
